capabilities: Add today's date line to a note when it is opened, once per day
Configure the line template, date format and duplicate-detection format
Scope stamping to notes by property, folder or the whole vault
Insert the date manually in any note via a command
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes tool; it stamps dates into notes you already open rather than creating new dated notes.
extras: README includes a Chinese-language section and manual installation steps; notes are edited atomically when not open in the editor to avoid clashes with sync or other plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically start a new dated section each time you reopen a running log, journal or lab notebook.
summary: Date-stamping plugin that adds today's date to a note when you open it, once per day, using a configurable line template and date format.
